_comment: Complete Settings.json reference. Copy values into Config/Settings.json as needed.
All settings shown here are required. Whole-number limits are validated before a run starts.
Properties named _comment or beginning with _comment_ are ignored by Server Postflight.
_comment_LogFolder: Folder for text logs and CSV files. Relative paths start beside ServerPostflight.ps1.
_comment_ReportFolder: Folder for the timestamped HTML reports. Relative paths start beside ServerPostflight.ps1.
_comment_HttpTimeoutSeconds: Maximum wait for one HTTP request. Allowed: 1 through 300.
_comment_TcpTimeoutSeconds: Maximum wait for a TCP connection or TLS handshake. Allowed: 1 through 60.
_comment_RemoteTimeoutSeconds: Maximum wait for each remote CIM/WMI operation. Allowed: 1 through 300.
_comment_PingCount: Number of ICMP ping requests per server. Allowed: 1 through 10.
_comment_DefaultTcpPort: Port checked when a server entry omits Port. Allowed: 1 through 65535.
_comment_DefaultMaxResponseMilliseconds: Default web response warning limit. Use 0 to disable the limit.
_comment_ExpectedRebootWithinHours: Warn when requested uptime exceeds this many hours. Use 0 to disable reboot enforcement.
_comment_CertificateWarningDays: Warn when an HTTPS certificate expires within this many days. Use 0 to warn only at expiration.
_comment_CpuWarningPercent: Warn when CPU load is at or above this percentage. Allowed: 1 through 100.
_comment_MemoryWarningPercent: Warn when free memory is below this percentage. Allowed: 1 through 100.
_comment_DiskWarningPercent: Warn when free disk space is below this percentage. Allowed: 1 through 100.
_comment_DiskFailurePercent: Fail when free disk space is below this percentage. Must not exceed DiskWarningPercent.
_comment_SkipCertificateValidation: Use true only for a known endpoint with an untrusted certificate. Normally false.
_comment_SkipRemoteChecks: Use true to skip uptime, OS, memory, CPU, disk, service, and process checks.
_comment_UseCredentialDialog: Use true for a Windows credential dialog or false for a hidden console password prompt.
